capabilities: Hide selected files and folders from the file explorer
Toggle hiding with a ribbon button or command
Add or remove items from the file context menu
Edit one vault-relative path per line in settings
Update tracked descendants when a folder is renamed
disambiguation: Not a media or video streaming tool; it only hides file explorer entries while you share your screen.
extras: Desktop-only and needs Obsidian 1.15.1 or newer; relies on file-explorer DOM selectors and CSS :has(), so custom themes or Obsidian changes may affect it; pop-out windows are not supported; not yet accepted into the community directory. Hiding is a presentation aid only, not access control: search, backlinks, open tabs, quick switcher and the files themselves stay accessible.
intentEvidence: originated from a request to adapt File Hider, by Oliver Akins, but uses an independent implementation
motivation: Originated from a request to adapt File Hider by Oliver Akins, but uses an independent implementation.
problem: The file explorer shows every note in the vault, so private files appear on screen when you stream or share your desktop.

relations.evidence: originated from a request to adapt File Hider, by Oliver Akins, but uses an independent implementation
For users of the earlier local Stream Mode (urdh-file-hider-live), disable the old plugin before enabling this one.

summary: Toggles a separate list of files and folders hidden from Obsidian's file explorer, for streaming or screen sharing.
